evidence_for_priority: Run 43541247291 actual EE software sampling: from_chars(float) 34.49% and parse_float_list self 8.88% of sampled ingest user CPU. No claimed wall-time ceiling or formal workload identity.
scope: Only parse_float_list bodies of at least 128 bytes, admitted nearest-rounding x86-64 IEEE float/double environment. At most 15 total decimal digits with a leading integer digit, optional minus and decimal point; complete token delimiter required. At the first declined token, all remaining coordinates in that vector use the original block.
change: Exact binary64 integer numerator and power-of-ten denominator, one nearest division, then direct float cast only if the intermediate is not a binary32 midpoint. Midpoints, exponent/hex/plus, longer or unsupported forms keep the original direct-float from_chars and strtof fallback.
prediction: Could reduce common short fixed-decimal parsing cost. Long/scientific representations may gain nothing or regress; first-decline fallback bounds repeated failed probes. Small bodies deliberately retain the original route. CPU improvement may not overcome COMMIT wall variability.
numeric_oracle: Direct rational integer quotient/remainder rounding to 24-bit binary32 with tie-even, never float(Fraction) followed by float32 conversion. Include actual double-rounding counterexamples, signed zero, midpoint neighbors, non-NUL views and end guards.
build_flags: Primary native oracle and micro use the actual root GCC13.3 -O3 -std=c++17 -fno-math-errno flags and static linkage. The additional host ASan/UBSan test enables -frounding-math. This choice was fixed before the first native run; root Docker flags do not change.
native_checks: Complete old/new parser accept/reject, partial output and exact float32 bits
Direct candidate acceptance against independent rational fixture
Rounding, exception masks, DAZ/FTZ and unsupported environment fallback
Actual root image, public cases, protocol differential, exact TopK and existing recovery regressions
microbenchmark: Separate eight-pair AB/BA whole-parser comparisons for dimensions 1,16,128,768; fixed-six-digit, mixed, scientific, full17-digit, float32-expanded-to-double representation and midpoint families. Preserve every result; no database or E conversion.
performance: Unchanged EE12 primary thresholds, then same-host parent ablation12. R protections and independent confirmation remain required for full adoption; no adjustment of earlier gates based on these results.
